title: Pin Check
statement: Implement `solve(lines, name)`. `lines` are frozen pins of the form `package==version`. Return the version string for `name`. If `name` is absent, return the string `none`. Match the package name exactly. Do not return a JSON null.
constraints: The missing marker is the string none
hints: Compare the package side to name before you look at the next line.
Absence is the string none so the judge can see it. Do not skip the return.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: A lock line answers the question a direct dependency asks: what version was installed.

editorial: A lock line answers the question a direct dependency asks: what version was installed. Scanning until the name matches is enough because a frozen file lists each distribution once. Returning a visible missing marker keeps the function total.
